discovery.name: Nereus
discovery.citation: Named for the ancient Greek god Nereus, a son of Pontus and Gaia.  A benevolent sea-god associated with ancient origins (mythology, if not science), he had the power of prophecy.  Name proposed by Robert M. Cutler, a Planetary Society member interested in near-Earth asteroids.  To English-language speakers the name seems very appropriate for such an object.
